description: Verify the payTo / receiving wallet an x402 seller demands before you sign. Same check as preflight_check: live 402 probe + history.payToChanges (wallet rotations) and priceChanges. Use when confirming which Base USDC address you will pay, comparing payTo to an allowlist, or detecting a rug-style wallet swap. Charged per URL via MCP x402 payment.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the x402 seller endpoint (the resource you are about to pay)
